findings.defect: The draft changes Taekyung’s statement that he will retrieve his sword into an instruction for Pung Yang to return it.
findings.rationale: Taekyung immediately performs the action himself by pulling the sword from Pung Yang’s chest.

findings.current: By the time the two-hour search was over, Lee Seowol’s body was soaked in blood.
findings.defect: The search duration is halved: two shichen equal approximately four hours, not two.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly gives the duration as 두 시진, preserving the quantity is required.
findings.replacement: By the time the four-hour search was over, Lee Seowol’s body was soaked in blood.
findings.source: 장장 두 시진에 걸친 수색 작업이 끝났을 때쯤, 이소월의 몸은 핏물로 흠뻑 젖어 있었다.

findings.current: Her broken fingernails dug into her flesh as she drew her bowstring, and blood seeped out, but she felt no pain.
findings.defect: The draft makes Lee Seowol draw her bowstring in the present moment, whereas the source identifies her nails as having been broken from drawing the bowstring; she is currently clenching her fist.
findings.rationale: This preserves the causal origin of the damaged nails and the current physical action established by the preceding sentence.
findings.replacement: Her fingernails, broken from drawing the bowstring, dug into her flesh as she clenched her fist. Blood seeped out, but she felt no pain.
findings.source: 활시위를 당기며 깨진 손톱이 살을 파고들며 피가 배어 나왔지만 고통도 느끼지 못했다.

findings.current: To be precise, if not for the Quest rewards, half of them might have been preparing funerals.
findings.defect: The draft makes half of the wounded prepare funerals rather than conveying that funerals might have been held for half of them because they would have died.
findings.rationale: The surrounding explanation credits the healing rewards with preventing the wounded from dying; the current subject assignment obscures that consequence.
findings.replacement: To be precise, if not for the Quest rewards, there might have been funerals for half of them.
findings.source: 정확히 말하면 퀘스트 보상이 아니었으면 저들 중 절반은 초상을 치렀을지도 모르겠다.

findings.current: The surviving martial artists of the Mount Heng Sword Sect gripped their weapons with murderous eyes.
findings.defect: “With murderous eyes” is an unnatural attachment and does not use the established rendering of 살기.
findings.rationale: The source describes killing intent suffusing their gazes, and “killing intent” is the binding terminology.
findings.replacement: The surviving martial artists of the Mount Heng Sword Sect gripped their weapons, their eyes brimming with killing intent.
findings.source: 살아남은 항산검문의 무인들이 살기 어린 눈빛으로 각자의 병장기를 움켜쥐었다.

findings.current: Body-Protecting Qi was an invincible armor that could not even scratch under anything short of powerful Sword Energy.
findings.defect: The sentence is grammatically malformed and makes the armor sound like the agent unable to scratch something else.
findings.rationale: The source says that only powerful Sword Energy can damage the defensive barrier.
findings.replacement: Body-Protecting Qi was invincible armor that nothing short of powerful Sword Energy could put so much as a scratch on.
findings.source: 호신강기는 강력한 검기(劍氣)가 아닌 이상 생채기 하나 낼 수 없는 무적의 갑옷.

findings.current: Pung Yang realized that his own death had taken a great stride toward him.
findings.defect: “Had taken a great stride toward him” is a conspicuous Korean-syntax calque rather than natural English.
findings.rationale: The replacement naturally conveys the source image of death having drawn suddenly and imminently close without changing the meaning.
findings.replacement: Pung Yang realized that his own death was almost upon him.
findings.source: 풍양은 자신의 죽음이 코앞으로 성큼 다가왔음을 깨달았다.

summary: Several action, quantity, consequence, terminology, and natural-English issues are actionable.
